item.title: How much you need to be middle class in New York and New Jersey
item.description: The definition of middle class in the United States is always evolving, and changes drastically from state to state.With cost of living and salary as two major factors, are you considered middle class where you live?A recent study revealed the lowest income needed to be considered middle class in each state, ranging from $39,418 to $69,885 — more than a $30,000 difference!In New York, you need to earn at least $57,213 this year, which is nearly $2,500 more than last year. item.title: Bruce Springsteen's tour is coming to New York City and Newark this spring
item.description: "The Boss" is heading back on the road this spring, and he's making three stops in the New York City area for four shows!Bruce Springsteen and The E Street Band will take the stage twice in New York City, once in Brooklyn and once in Newark:Newark: April 20 at the Pudential CenterNew York City: May 11 and 16 at Madison Square GardenBrooklyn: May 14 at the Barclays CenterThe "Land of Hope And Dreams American Tour" will kick off in Minneapolis on March 31, ending in the nation's capital on May 27.
